notes_for_editor: Build and destruction years agree across three sources; the CCC photo independently places a tower on Uranus Peak around 1938. Idaho Fire Lookouts lists two known staff under year headings, Lorenzo Lanter (1935) and Ernest Milot (1937); both are stored as staffed events. No source gives access or the site's condition today, so access level is unset. Record elevation_m is null; the sources give 4,977 ft (about 1,517 m), which has no facts key and was not stored. The CCC photo image URL was not captured, so no photos entry was added. The Coeur d'Alene NF attribution rests on the association and Forest Lookouts pages; the one web search found no other history.
